honestGapNotes: enforcer-mcp has no full/lite Cargo feature split of its own; its enforcer-coordination dependency ALREADY leaked into enforcer-cli's --features lite build before this workpack (cargo tree -p enforcer-cli --no-default-features --features lite -i enforcer-coordination shows it present via enforcer-mcp and enforcer-plan). This workpack's new enforcer-mcp -> enforcer-ui edge inherits the identical leak. The lite_help_omits_full_only_subcommands test (grammar-level) still passes because clap's --help output is unaffected by what is merely LINKED; the crate doc comment's claim that lite 'excludes that dependency from the graph entirely' was already inaccurate before this change and remains so. Recorded in memory/streams/g01.ndjson (mem-g01-0003) as a pre-existing gap, not a regression -- a real fix requires feature-gating enforcer-mcp's own dependencies, outside this workpack's owns:.

No real Ctrl+C/SIGINT handler is wired for the UI serve surface's shutdown path; run_serve_ui's shutdown predicate always reports "keep running" (documented honestly in main.rs). A caller stops the surface by killing the process today, same as any long-running local dev server.
